data.body: RESUME TRAP (append to pause checkpoint): change 1727 shows LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 but on STALE revision f34549d099 — it MUST NOT be submitted as-is (that revision stamps the last-sweep clock on stand-aside, silently suppressing the compaction floor under contention).
